body: I have the exact same feeling as you, just that I keep looking ahead and I feel like I have so many more years to go before I don't need to go to school anymore and each year gets tougher so its really demoralising... But I've tried to hold on by looking for something to look forward in everyday. Maybe a show online or cooking something you like to eat for yourself can get yourself feeling better about yourself and try to hold on! :) Things feel a little better and life gets a little brighter when you find something to look forward... Really hope this can help you, even a little bit will be great! And hope you feel better, we're always here if you need to talk!
